name: CHAOS-3807 Lane E public sharding integration guards
$limitation: Pins only the shared-harness dispatch, coordinator-child durable result bridge, and public recovery bridge. Execution-tree, coordinator aggregation, and recovery authority guards remain covered by the Lane B, C, and D plans.

mutations.rationale: A reviewed request above one shard must enter the coordinator path instead of silently executing the serial path.
A child measurement must be durable before its terminal event so the coordinator never accepts an event-only result that was lost on abort.

mutations.replace: return f"recovered run {run_id} as aborted; removed 0 owned shard(s)"
mutations.rationale: The public recovery command must invoke the authority-checked recovery backend; reporting success without cleanup would leave coordinator state and owned trees behind.

mutations.replace:
if False and not owned_roots:
                temporary_root.rmdir()
mutations.rationale: After every owned execution tree is removed, the coordinator must also remove its now-empty private run root instead of leaking a durable temporary directory.
